stem:
Meena's school in Pune sets up a small fish pond on the campus. The students must manage the pond so that it supports ecosystem health, not just fish production.
Which practice would best support the health of this human-made ecosystem in the long term?

options.text: Adding extra chemical fertiliser to the pond every week so the fish grow as fast as possible
Growing water plants around the pond, limiting fish numbers, and using kitchen-waste compost in moderate amounts
Removing all the pond plants so that more sunlight reaches the water for the fish
Releasing a new fast-breeding foreign fish species to increase the fish yield quickly

teacher.key_rationale: Ecosystem health requires balanced management: native water plants support biodiversity and oxygen, moderate compost avoids nutrient overload and pollution, and controlled fish numbers keep the pond sustainable long term. A causes chemical pollution and algal blooms; C reduces biodiversity and oxygen; D risks the invasive species outcompeting native organisms. Hence B.
